The institutional investor held 50,000 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $8.39M, up from 45,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Trb Advisors Lp who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $935.06B market cap company. The stock increased 1.80% or $3.37 during the last trading session, reaching $190.24. About 21.25M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 3, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
Ed Beddow decreased its stake in Chevron Corp (CVX) by 32.17% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. The hedge fund run by Ed Beddow held 8,935 shares of the integrated oil company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.02M, down from 13,173 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Beddow Capital Management Inc who had been investing in Chevron Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $236.67 billion market cap company.
